units.source_text: 三十六万九千五百只河童因而，为此英勇牺牲了。

en.t: As a result, three hundred sixty-nine thousand five hundred kappa heroically sacrificed themselves for this cause.

units.source_text: 不过和敌国相比，这点损失就无所谓了。

en.t: But compared with the enemy country, such a loss was insignificant.

units.source_text: 我国的皮毛基本上都是水獭皮。

en.t: The furs in our country are basically all otter pelts.

units.source_text: 战争期间，除了制造玻璃，我还把煤渣运到战场上。”

en.t: During the war, besides making glass, I also transported coal cinders to the battlefield.
